name: Did That One Just Come Out Of My

scriptData.label: @effect.name
Roll to remove Stunned

effects.name: Did That One Just Come Out Of My

description.label: Description
description.value:
A projectile slams into the side of your thigh, high up near the hip. It burrows through the meat and then exits at the back just above the gluteal sulcus (the crease separating thigh from buttock) in a spray of blood.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Stunned] (1) and @Condition[Bleeding] (1). For the next 1d10 days you also suffer a penalty of -1 to your M and will have problems sitting down. You now also have a hole in your pants.
